title: D-093 R075: the research-record check chooses the governing review by revision and parsed time, so a same-day date-only entry never reads as older; malformed review dates are refused
objective: Fix tools/research_record_check.py so the review that governs a record's review state is the one for the highest reviewed revision, ties broken by the parsed UTC time (a date-only entry = start of its day) and then by order; refuse review dates in any other form; add tests for the mixed-format cases.
business_reason: The check compared review dates as strings, so on NB-01 a date-only revision-3 review sorted before a timed revision-2 review and the record read stale; the owner asked for a permanent fix instead of a logged workaround (D-093 R075).

acceptance_scenarios.given: a record whose reviews are a revision-2 entry dated with a time ('2026-10-11T02:13Z') followed by a revision-3 entry dated '2026-10-11' (the NB-01 case), code unchanged
acceptance_scenarios.when: the check derives the review state
acceptance_scenarios.then: the revision-3 entry governs and the state is current

acceptance_scenarios.given: two reviews of the same revision, one date-only and one with a time on the same day
acceptance_scenarios.when: the check derives the review state
acceptance_scenarios.then: the governing review is chosen by revision, then by the parsed time, then by order; a date-only entry counts as the start of its day

acceptance_scenarios.given: a review whose date is neither YYYY-MM-DD nor a UTC date-and-time (e.g. '11/10/2026' or '2026-10-11 07:26')
acceptance_scenarios.then: the record is refused with a message naming the review and the expected forms
it passes; NB-01, NB-05 and NB-06 read current

acceptance_scenarios.given: the existing tests of the check
acceptance_scenarios.then: all pass unchanged except where a test pinned the old string comparison, which is explained

risks: A stricter date check could refuse an existing record; every committed record must still pass (S4).
Wave 23's other tasks hold review entries in NB-01, NB-05, NB-06: no record file is edited by this task.
